# `translate`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Translates the `input` string by replacing the characters present in the `from` string with the corresponding characters in the `to` string.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
translate(input, from, to)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- translate, example 1
> SELECT translate('AaBbCc', 'abc', '123');
A1B2C3
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
